entries.reviewNotes: Read restaurant context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Small-portion choice, personal strong-flavor impression and no obligation to order more remain distinct from criticism of preparation; service/customer roles retained.

Read construction record-assistant context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Checked no completion-date promise, no disclosure of schedule, no entry permission, return to records and explicit handover. Hindi reception wording corrected to a reception desk rather than abstract welcome.

Read bank merchant-payment consultation context and all twelve turn/hint sets. Checked one-day outdoor use, unconfirmed power and communications, no home-operation guarantee, contract/billing-period questions and delayed advertising; no bank approval implied.

Read station service-counter context and all twelve turn/hint sets. Checked number twelve, preserving queue priority while sitting with luggage, visible call display and responding to number rather than following another customer. Corrected Hindi/Bengali thanks response to natural service register.

Read temple-room entry context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Laced boots, seated preparation out of queue, coordinating entry with companion and delaying next plan to allow shoes on departure are preserved. No real temple policy added.

Read shrine photography context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Checked five family members with brother photographing the other four in two rows, one shot, yielding space, brother photographed elsewhere and all bags collected. No substantive translation error found.

Read guided castle-site tour context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Headcount notification before toilet departure, wife continuing independently, clock at exit meeting, no other tour queue and take-home guide checked. Source hint at turn8 simplifies avoidance of other groups but dialogue is preserved.

Read hospital visiting context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Father’s rest preference, letter only today, photos on later requested visit and no immediate long reply preserved. Vietnamese staff question corrected so the visitor is asked what to say to father, not greeted by the question.

Read police-visit consultation context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Six children aged seven to nine, one current adult and possible second escort, two candidate dates and no vehicle-ride promise retained; no service availability or personal-data collection approval inferred.

Read sister souvenir-shopping context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Different color preferences, navy versus white comparison, matching small brooch design, two brooches only and no clothing purchase retained. Sister relationship and staff/customer roles remain coherent.

Read castle stone-wall guide context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Thirty-minute availability, gate-near short tour, viewing whole shape before corner joints and using remaining time from current position preserved; no construction instruction added.

Read self-service udon context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Only own used tray, dishes and chopsticks returned while friend eats; permission to wait, asking friend before water and final glasses/bag check preserved. Burmese return wording clarified to used dishes.

Read smoke-affected platform waiting context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Same next local service, new waiting position with display visible, bag moved and staff checking smoke retained. Khmer easy-to-see phrase corrected to avoid contempt meaning; English boarding area clarified.

Read festival paper-flower handover context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Red entrance versus white stage, twenty/thirty counts, ten per bundle yielding two/three bundles, separate shallow boxes and no stacking preserved. No substantive issue found.

Read late-night convenience-store overnight essentials context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Toothbrush with case, small face towel, two-pair socks, 1300 yen plus five-yen bag equals1305 under1500 checked. Product counts and purchasing roles coherent.

Read izakaya slow-meal context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Two empty plates cleared, grilled-food plate/chopsticks retained, no transfer or new dish, water only and customer later telling staff to clear checked. Khmer reflexive changed from telling oneself to personally notifying staff; Burmese hint clarified staff removal.

Read ferry-terminal separate boarding context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Driver and pedestrian companion use separate reception, companion leaves station, own tickets retained and meeting at side waiting area of onboard information desk checked. Cabin/lounge wording remains general passenger space.

Read fish-box sorting context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Distinct carrier/counter roles, count after placement not lifting, current four then five, matching carrier count and record-backed handover before additions preserved. No substantive translation issue found.

Read whole-fish portion/trimmings request context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Two similarly sized portions for two, soup trimmings separately wrapped, cooler bag and storage-label dependent use order preserved. Hindi customer request corrected from giving to asking seller to give packages.

Read curry-shop work-clothes protection context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Jacket on hook, apron fastened before sitting/service, loosened neck, front covering shirt, basket return and jacket retrieval checked. Burmese splash verb corrected; Japanese front/back tie detail retained without invention.

Read police-box previous-consultation contact update context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Last Thursday around14:00, staff-name note, old number unusable, new number and preferred noon/after18:00 contact times preserved; timing remains preference without promise.

Read hospital post-payment departure assistance context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Can stand/sit but long corridor difficult, hospital wheelchair/staff offer, main entrance shelter identified from diagram, family notified and seated waiting checked. No clinical judgment or new medical advice added.

Read library read-aloud relocation context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Quiet users, children’s seats, controlled voice with pictures, skipped-page check and return-place question checked. Tagalog choose-with-child syntax corrected so it cannot mean choose a child.

Read tax-office limited consultation context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Five questions with two answered and three deferred, October issue versus September covered month, monthly deposits and home details preserved. Simplified Chinese 看法 changed to reading method; no tax determination added.

Read tea-shop no-teapot context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Tea bag habit, strainer fit in small cup, noted strainer width, small leaf purchase only and return after measuring home cup preserved. Thai closing corrected so shop welcomes another visit rather than waiting to receive service.

Read tea-picking sample-selection context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Speed comparison caused two unsuitable leaves, hardness/darker color checked with staff, sample kept nearby and pointing before picking doubtful leaves preserved. No agricultural recommendation beyond fictional dialogue inferred.

Read tea-experience context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Aroma enjoyed but strong taste unfamiliar, no forced extra sip, asking where to hold bowl with tea remaining and own impressions preserved. Permission not to finish stays limited to this fictional experience.

Read fictional Kōwaji temple seal-counter context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Final ji sound reconfirmed, reading written in own notebook without adding to goshuin, actual visit date recorded and ownership of returned book checked. No real temple identity or universal seal rule asserted.

Read sweet-shop decorative leaf context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Leaf explicitly not eaten for this product, grandfather receives two without decoration and self one with, same sweets separated into bags checked. Fictional product-specific explanation not generalized to all leaves.

Read two-destination taxi context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Friend to accommodation first then player to station, friend’s small bag kept close, only player’s large bag in rear, single final fare and later private split preserved. Both drop-offs completed before fare and own bag receipt.

Read post-dispatch omitted tea instructions context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Receipt retained, no insistence on box recovery, separate phone/photo instructions and correcting family’s packing assumption checked. English and Thai hint clarified forgotten insertion, not instructions left inside shipment.

Read community-event bank withdrawal context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Ten1000-yen notes total10000, not100000, bank does not prepare named recipient envelopes, self verifies cash and later organizer list/allocation checked. No real bank service guarantee added.

Read walking shopper gift-fruit weight context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Empty sample distinguished from actual fruit plus box weight, other household bag, one uncle recipient and actual two-fruit small box selected checked. No general carrying-capacity guarantee inferred.

Read park pretend-shop materials context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Child stopped before mouth contact, unidentified fallen fruits not treated as food, drawings substituted and held by adult, papers counted/home collected checked. Hindi fallen-tree modifier corrected to fallen fruits.

Read station vending-machine failure context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Paid140yen for water with no drink/change, no second insertion or shaking, management contact/machine number and purchase-time note checked. Station refund inability stays scenario-specific.

Read city dance experience registration context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Three practices available on days off, separate later performance application, no promised performance leave, blank performance field and noted belongings checked. Vietnamese time-off wording clarified to avoid resignation meaning.

Read different-crutches instruction context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Previous experience insufficient, no self shortening, seated waiting, single entrance step query, family car and staff accompaniment checked. Vietnamese observer role and Bengali unspecified length difference corrected.

Read returned-wallet gratitude consultation context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Contents checked, no direct finder-contact disclosure, short factual thanks through staff, reward discussion secondary and no promised reply preserved. Hindi hint identifies finder who handed wallet in.

Read cash-on-delivery cash-shortfall context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets.1000yen missing, no partial-payment assumption, home preparation and return by16:00 with notice/documents and no refusal checked. Hindi/Bengali shortfall wording clarified rather than small payment.

Read bank borrowed reading-glasses context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Near text versus distant clock, seated reading, text recognition distinct from understanding, preferred contact field and returning glasses before movement checked. Source turn10 mentions box return before removal-before-standing; preserved canonical wording rather than rewriting Japanese chronology.

Read bakery delayed-consumption context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. One-hour trip, cancel shop heating, product/appliance instructions at home, no assumed bag-heating permission, unwarmed receipt and informing companion checked. No unsupported appliance timing added.

Read park Bon-dance practice entry context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Arrived midway, watch outside first, enter next song via designated opening, observe instructor feet, rest outside keeping opening clear and ask staff before rejoining checked. Speaker registers coherent.

Read fishing-rod station handling context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Not yet extended, protruding tip repacked, no shoulder-height swinging or seat placement, self support and tackle preparation postponed checked. Route already known and rod kept packed through rail trip preserved.

Read municipal map walking-time context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Ten minutes starts at station not home, own pace/route affect time, prior-day partial route check, resting spots and early departure checked. Chinese home location clarified as beyond shopping street.

Read inpatient heavy-book resting context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Tired arms risk dropping book onto chest, close and side-table placement, rest now, bed settings only after explanation, thinner replacement via family and call button checked. No clinical posture technique supplied.

Read bicycle-signal class left/right confusion context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Same-facing view replaces mirrored demonstration, stationary off-bike practice and spacing, single movement not all road signals learned, next staff instruction order checked. No unsupported specific road signals added.

Read already-shipped parcel preferred-time context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Tuesday evening available versus Wednesday morning unavailable, sender preference not delivery designation, accepted result/number recorded, family home plan and advance change-method check preserved.

Read explicitly fictional US-dollar exchange context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Two10-dollar bills total20, coins excluded/retained,150yen per dollar gives3000 minus100fee equals2900, receipt/bills/coin bag cross-check preserved. Example transaction not represented as current exchange rate.

Read whole-fish home-equipment consultation context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Small knife limitation, grilling portions rather than pictured whole fish, head/bones option declined, pan-fitting size requested and numbered preparation order maintained checked.

Read park cleanup pre-break handover context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Friend asked to wait, own single litter bag contents described without asserting others’, water bottle/jacket kept private, tools returned and collected bag handed to staff before break preserved.

Read three-friend travel ticket consultation context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Shared midday outbound, only player returns early for family commitment, friends’ return undecided and not chosen for them, own round-trip purchase checked. No imposed identical itinerary.

Read parent-child preparation for first solo home journey context and all twelve complete turn/hint sets. Next week solo versus today accompanied, child speaks destination first, staff-help phrase, real-ticket route practice and child-held paper destination checked. Parent helps unclear parts without answering all.

changes.before: Hôm nay chào bạn muốn nói gì?
changes.after: Trong lời chào hỏi hôm nay, bạn muốn nói gì với bố?

changes.after: I'll watch the display while waiting. When boarding information appears, I'll calmly head to that service's boarding area.
